deepDiveBlocks.heading: Medication Continuity And EPS
paragraphs: Repeat prescription services help patients stay on regular medicines without gaps. EPS nomination sends prescriptions electronically from your GP surgery to your chosen pharmacy.
Our team advises on reorder timing, coordinates with your surgery when authorisation is delayed, and supports carers managing medicines for others.

preparationGuide: GP surgery name and repeat slip
List of repeat items and intervals

timelineNotes: Order 7–10 days before medicines run out
Allow extra time after bank holidays
Nomination changes take effect on next prescription
comparisonPoints: Pharmacy cannot authorise repeats without GP approval
EPS reduces collection delays compared with paper prescriptions
